key_notes: Key 1 (t=5.6s): Initial archival pose of line; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=6.72s): Mid-sequence articulation of line; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=7.96s): Peak dynamic extension of line over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=9.2s): Follow-through and settle of line with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of line (5.6s..9.2s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
